'''Vari'kalwes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] merchant who resided in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
